item.title: Bentleigh — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Every Melbourne suburb has a story. Bentleigh’s story is one of farmland and orchards that became suburban housing in the post-war boom. Understanding that history explains why the suburb feels the way it does today.

See our full Bentleigh suburb guide for the current picture.

What Bentleigh Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Bentleigh was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

item.title: Bentleigh Neighbourhood Guide — Streets and Pockets
item.description:
Bentleigh isn’t one monolithic block. Like most Melbourne suburbs, it has different pockets with different personalities. Here’s how to read the suburb from the inside.

Bentleigh Isn’t Just One Thing

Walk from one end of Bentleigh to the other and you’ll notice the vibe shift. The main commercial strip has one energy. The residential streets behind it have another. And the edges of the suburb — where it bleeds into Brighton East — have their own thing going on.

item.title: Cost of Living in Bentleigh Melbourne
item.description:
Money matters when you’re choosing where to live. Here’s the real story on costs in Bentleigh — no sugar-coating, no made-up figures.

Read our full Bentleigh suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Bentleigh Expensive?

Bentleigh sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Bentleigh, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
